newsitem.title: FINLAND: ESTONIA'S HANSAPANK REGROUPS AS SIX UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA'S HANSAPANK REGROUPS AS SIX UNITS.

text.p: Estonian bank AS Hansapank -- listed on the Helsinki Stock Exchange's brokers list -- said in a statement on Friday it was changing its organisation by dividing activities into six structural units.

It said the reorganisation was necessary due to its transformation from a local Estonian company into an international group, and it added that the restructuring was purely managerial with no legal changes.

"The main change is the centralisation of local market services under Hansapank Estonia, which is at the same organisational level with Hansapank Latvia and Hansa Leasing," it said. These units were essentially sales units, it added.
Development at the international level and expansion to new markets would be coordinated by the management and the other three divisions, it said.

It appointed former director of corporate banking Indrek Neivelt managing director of Hansapank Estonia. Gerd Muller would succeed him on the corporate side, moving from his current position as director of retail banking, it said.
